filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(prior_results=hotels, has_kids_club=True)

save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels_kids_club", value=filtered_hotels)

# Apply the additional filter for Romanian cuisine to the restaurant results
filtered_restaurants = filter_restaurants(prior_results=restaurants, cuisine=["Romanian"])

# Save the refined restaurant results back to cache with a new key
save_to_cache(key="filtered_restaurants_romanian", value=filtered_restaurants)

# Find the nearest restaurants to the filtered hotels
nearest_restaurants = search_nearest(hotels=filtered_hotels, restaurants=filtered_restaurants, groupBy="restaurant")

# Save the nearest restaurant results to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_restaurants_to_hotels", value=nearest_restaurants)
